content.title: Venezuela confirmed lineup and starting pitcher against Team USA in the 2026 World Baseball Classic final
content.text: Team Venezuela has traditionally been one of the toughest teams in the competition. This year, once again, they are determined to make it to the final, despite missing some big names, but they are still playing impressive baseball and will face powerhouse Team USA in the final.Their strong pitching, excellent hitting and tough defense has taken Venezuela this far. This game will be a clash of titans, which will come down to bullpen strength and hitting.Venezuela confirmed lineup against Team USARonald Acuña Jr. (RF)Maikel Garcia (3B)Luis Arraez (1B)Eugenia Suarez (DH)Gleyber Torres (2B)Ezequiel Tovar (SS)Wilyer Abreu (LF)Salvador Perez (C)Jackson Chourio (CF)Venezuela’s starting pitcher against Italy: Eduardo RodriguezTeam Venezuela 2026 World Baseball Classic rosterCoaching staffHead coach: Omar LópezBench coach: Robinson ChirínosPitching coach: Jorge CórdovaHitting coach: Miguel CabreraFirst base coach: Gerardo ParraThird base coach: Rouglas OdorInfieldersLuis ArraezWillson ContrerasMaikel GarciaAndrés GiménezEugenio SuárezGleyber TorresEzequiel TovaOutfieldersWilyer AbreuRonald Acuña Jr.Jackson ChourioJavier SanojaCatchersWilliam ContrerasSalvador Perez (Royals)PitchersEduard BazardoYoendrys GómezPablo LópezGermán MárquezDaniel PalenciaJose AlvaradoOddanier MosquedaRicardo SánchezAngel ZerpaJosé ButtóCarlos GuzmanAndrés MachadoKeider MonteroAntonio SenzatelaEmmanuel De JesusEduardo RodríguezRanger SuárezVeteran José Altuve will have to sit out the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
